audit.evidence: Real published npm mongoose bytes via aliases mongoose@8.8.2(v0)/8.8.3(v1)/8.9.5(v2) in a node:20 HTTP service backed by a real mongo:7 database; populate().match $where sift injection. 4-way closure on real Docker: original@v0 flag ([{$where}]), blocked@v1 (non-recursive guard throws), bypass@v1 flag ($or-nested $where past top-level guard), residual@v2 blocked (recursive throwOn$where).

v0.ref: npm mongoose@8.8.2 lib/helpers/populate/getModelsMapForPopulate.js (pre CVE-2024-53900: NO $where guard on populate match; a $where in the match reaches sift and runs arbitrary JS in the Node process)

v1.ref: npm mongoose@8.8.3 lib/helpers/populate/getModelsMapForPopulate.js (CVE-2024-53900 fix, GHSA-m7xq-9374-9rvx, commit c9e86bff/33679bc): NON-recursive guard throws 'Cannot use $where filter with populate() match' on a top-level $where; INCOMPLETE re: $where nested inside $or/$and

v2.ref: npm mongoose@8.9.5 lib/helpers/populate/getModelsMapForPopulate.js (CVE-2025-23061 fix, GHSA-vg7j-7cwx-8wgw, commit 64a9f970): RECURSIVE throwOn$where walks every nested key, blocking $where inside $or/$and

evidence.fix_reference: npm mongoose@8.8.3 lib/helpers/populate/getModelsMapForPopulate.js (CVE-2024-53900 fix, GHSA-m7xq-9374-9rvx, commit c9e86bff/33679bc): NON-recursive guard throws 'Cannot use $where filter with populate() match' on a top-level $where; INCOMPLETE re: $where nested inside $or/$and; npm mongoose@8.9.5 lib/helpers/populate/getModelsMapForPopulate.js (CVE-2025-23061 fix, GHSA-vg7j-7cwx-8wgw, commit 64a9f970): RECURSIVE throwOn$where walks every nested key, blocking $where inside $or/$and
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Mongoose before 8.9.5 can improperly use a nested $where filter with a populate() match, leading to search injection. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-53900.

provenance.notes: Faithful-core harness: the REAL npm `mongoose` package installed per-version via npm aliases (mongoose@8.8.2=V0, 8.8.3=V1, 8.9.5=V2); guard = the per-version getModelsMapForPopulate $where sanitizer driven through the real Mongoose API Author.find().populate({path:'books', match:<filter>}) against a real MongoDB 7. Array-form match routes the filter through sift in-process (assignVals -> sift), where $where compiles a string via new Function('return '+expr); the benign predicate `true` merely widens the populate match to admit the protected secret book (read-exfil canary), no offensive payload. Variant A gate passes on V0+V1; V2 built as negative control (residual blocked).
